Hello, Yun Astro!

2024-01-01 Blog

Hello, Yun Astro! ☁️

Welcome to the Astro version of hexo-theme-yun.

This is a minimal, fast, and beautiful blog theme powered by Astro.

Features

  • 🌙 Light / Dark / Sunset theme modes
  • 📁 Categories & Tags pages
  • 📅 Archives page
  • 🎨 Customizable via src/config.ts
  • ⚡ Zero-JS by default – scripts only where needed
  • 🔍 SEO-friendly with sitemap & Open Graph

Writing posts

Add .md or .mdx files to src/content/posts/:

---
title: My Post Title
date: 2024-06-15
tags: [Astro, Blog]
categories: [Tech]
description: Short summary shown on the list page.
---

Your content here...

Code highlighting

const greet = (name: string) => `Hello, ${name}!`;
console.log(greet('Yun'));

Enjoy writing! 🎉
